{npc:Rotem Valos}, of the Adventurers' Guild, needs help mapping the lands of Tibia. He gives you an {item:Adventurer's Map} and a list of 18 places to explore (all added in version 10.80). You visit each place in any order, use the map there and, when you mark the last one, you get the achievement **Cartography 101**.
The Adventurers' Guild needs help mapping the lands of Tibia.
No minimum level, but level 100+ is recommended: you will pass through areas with strong creatures.
Two of the locations are only accessible during Mini World Changes: the Iceberg ({wiki:Chakoya Iceberg Mini World Change}) and the inside of the Hive Outpost ({wiki:Hive Outpost Mini World Change}).
given by Rotem Valos at the start
Money for travel (Port Hope, Liberty Bay, Edron, Cormaya, Ankrahmun, Venore).
Health and mana potions: there are dangerous creatures in several locations.
Quest marked as completed in the Quest Log (Adventurers Guild)
You can do the 18 locations in any order. Group them by region to save on travel (this is how this guide is organised).
At each location you just need to use the {item:Adventurer's Map} in the right spot; you do not have to kill anything in particular.

If the Iceberg or the Hive Outpost are not active, do the other locations first and come back when the Mini World Change shows up (the Hive Outpost can be marked from the outside even without the MWC active).

The {wiki:Adventurers' Guild} is on an island **west** of Thais lighthouse. Go to the temple of any city and use an {item:Adventurer's Stone}: you are teleported to the guild. If you do not have one, ask a temple NPC for another: {key:hi}, {key:adventurer's stone}, {key:yes}. To leave, use the guild's exit portal, which takes you back to the temple you came from.
Go to the {wiki:Adventurers' Guild} and talk to {npc:Rotem Valos}. Say {key:hi}, {key:map} and {key:yes}. You receive the {item:Adventurer's Map}. Say {key:list} to hear the clues for the locations.
These are the 18 locations to mark (names as they appear in the server log). At each one, use the {item:Adventurer's Map} at the indicated spot.
Six locations around Port Hope. Travel to Port Hope and do them back to back.

Take the boat to **Port Hope** at your city's harbour ({key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes}). You arrive next to {npc:Charles}. All the locations in this section are in the Tiquanda jungle, around the city; between each one, return to Port Hope or continue on foot.

Go to the Tiquanda side of the {wiki:Kha'zeel Pass} and walk **north** until you find the {wiki:Asura Palace}. Go into the palace and use the {item:Adventurer's Map}. Watch out for the cracks (*Some Cracks*) at the far **west** of the ground floor and the hole (*Pitfall*) in the green area: they make you fall into rooms with {creature:Lich|Liches} and {creature:Hydra|Hydras}. To leave, go out through the same entrance and return to Port Hope the same way.
The palace is occupied by demons. Do not go too deep: just walk in and use the map.
Asura Palace: use the Adventurer's Map here
Iceberg (only during the Mini World Change)

You can only get here during the {wiki:Chakoya Iceberg Mini World Change}. Walk **north** from Port Hope to the iceberg. Go up the stairs and head **northeast** to an igloo. Go into the igloo to be teleported down. Follow the path **west**, go down the hole, head **east** and go down the other hole. When you reach a big room, use the map. To leave, go back the same way and use the {item:Rope} to climb up the two holes you went down (the sources do not describe another exit from the igloo floor).
Iceberg: use the Adventurer's Map here

These are the {wiki:Kha'zeel Dragon Lairs/Tiquanda|Dragon Caves} in the Kha'zeel mountains. Go to the indicated spot and use the map. The lairs are on the Tiquanda side of the Kha'zeel mountains: the north entrance is at {coord:33009,32604,7} and the south one at {coord:32983,32646,7}. To leave, go back the same way to the entrance (bring a {item:Rope} for the holes).
Dragon Caves: use the map here
North entrance of the Dragon Lairs
South entrance of the Dragon Lairs
Dragon Caves: use the Adventurer's Map here

Enter the {wiki:Medusa Tower} through the tunnel and use the map on the tower's **ground floor**. The tower is in the **southwest** of Tiquanda, south of the Hunters/Dworcs camp: go down the hole **north** of the tower and enter the basement through the tunnel. To leave, go back through the tunnel and climb up the hole with the {item:Rope}.
Medusa Tower: use the Adventurer's Map here

Go down into Port Hope's {wiki:Water Elemental Dungeon} and use the map right near the entrance. The entrance is **south** of Port Hope ({coord:32679,32964,7}). To leave, go back up where you came down.
Near the Water Elemental Dungeon entrance
Water Elemental Dungeon in Port Hope: use the Adventurer's Map here

In Tiquanda's {wiki:Spider Caves}, go down **2 floors** and look for a room with {item:Muddy Water} and a {item:Lizard Statue}. Use the map there. The entrance is in the **southeast** of Tiquanda ({coord:32844,32871,7}). To leave, go back the same way to the entrance (bring a {item:Rope} for the holes).
Room with Muddy Water and Lizard Statue
Spider Caves in Tiquanda: use the Adventurer's Map here
Take the boat to **Liberty Bay** at your city's harbour ({key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}). The three locations in this section are around the city.

Enter the {wiki:Corym Black Market} and go down to **floor -4**. Use the map at the indicated spot. Enter through the {item:Sewer Grate} at {coord:32268,32835,7}, beneath Liberty Bay. To leave, go back up the four floors the same way to the grate.
Corym Black Market: use the Adventurer's Map here

In **Liberty Bay**, go **west** of the harbour until you find wreckage and a ramp that leads to the {wiki:Quara Grotto}. Go down the ramp and use the map on **floor -1**. To leave, go back up the same ramp.
Quara Grotto in Liberty Bay: use the Adventurer's Map here

From the Quara Grotto, go **northwest** and look for the ramp that leads to the {wiki:Hive Outpost}. Go in and use the map right at the surface level. To leave, go back up the same ramp and return **east** to Liberty Bay.
The Hive Outpost only opens during the {wiki:Hive Outpost Mini World Change}, but this location can be marked from the outside even when the MWC is not active.
Hive Outpost: use the Adventurer's Map here

Take the boat to **Edron** ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}); you arrive next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}. To go to {wiki:Cormaya} (Lair of the Treeling Witch and Dryad Gardens), say {key:cormaya} to him (20 gp); to come back, take the boat from Cormaya to Edron.
Go to the ruins of the {wiki:Old Fortress}, just **north of Edron**. You just need to use the map on the surface, in the middle of the ruins.
Old Fortress: use the Adventurer's Map here

Go to **Stonehome**, in the northern part, and talk to {npc:Cornell}. Ask him for a {key:passage} to Grimvale. As soon as you arrive, use the map. To come back, talk to {npc:Cornell} in the south of Grimvale and ask for {key:passage} again.
Grimvale: use the Adventurer's Map here

This is the {wiki:Edron Vampire Crypt}, **north** of Edron (enter through a small cave, at {coord:33109,31722,7}). Go down to **floor -4** and look for a room with pools of blood. Use the map there. To leave, use the teleport on the last floor ({coord:33019,31605,11}): it takes you to the Stone Blocks next to the cave entrance ({coord:33052,31698,8}); from there, climb up along the entrance path.
Room with pools of blood, floor -4
The crypt is full of vampires.
Blood Shrine: use the Adventurer's Map here

In the {wiki:Lair of the Treeling Witch}, northeast of Cormaya, go to the centre of **floor -1**, next to the witch's cauldron, and use the map. The entrance is in the **northeast** of Cormaya ({coord:33338,31972,7}). To leave, go back up the same way.
Entrance to the Lair of the Treeling Witch
Lair of the Treeling Witch: use the Adventurer's Map here

In the {wiki:Dryad Gardens} (entrance through a well on the west coast of Cormaya), find the central hill and climb up **twice** until you find an {creature:Earth Elemental}. Use the map there. The entrance is the {item:Stony Pond} **southwest** of the Cormaya boat ({coord:33264,32014,7}). To leave, go back the same way to the entrance.
Top of the central hill of the Dryad Gardens
Dryad Gardens: use the Adventurer's Map here

Take the boat to **Ankrahmun** ({key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes}); you arrive next to {npc:Captain Sinbeard}. The three locations are in the desert north and east of the city. Bring a {item:Shovel}: some entrances have to be dug open.

This is the {wiki:Mother of Scarabs Lair}. Go down to **floor -5**, where the {creature:Ancient Scarab|Ancient Scarabs} are. On that floor, go **southwest** until you find an altar and use the map near it. Entrances: north at {coord:33236,32577,7} and south at {coord:33290,32603,7} (you may need to dig a few times). To leave, go back the same way to the entrance (bring a {item:Rope} for the holes).
Desert Scarab Lair: use the Adventurer's Map here

This is the {wiki:Forbidden Temple}, east of Ankrahmun. Go down to **floor -2** and use the map anywhere on that floor. The entrance is at {coord:33315,32675,7}, hidden by a tree: you may need to dig a few times until it opens. To leave, go back the same way to the entrance (bring a {item:Rope} for the holes).
Forbidden Sanctuary: use the Adventurer's Map here
Forbidden Temple entrance (dig with the Shovel)

This is the {wiki:Kha'zeel Scarab Lair}. Go down to **floor -2** and use the map. The entrance is in the Kha'zeel mountains, north of the Kha'labal desert ({coord:33077,32547,7}). To leave, go back the same way to the entrance (bring a {item:Rope} for the holes).
Scarab Lair in the Mountains: use the Adventurer's Map here

These are the {wiki:Tainted Caves}, beneath the Venore swamps. Go down **one floor** and, **northeast** of the entrance, you find a central room with {item:Sulphur Stone|Sulphur Stones}. Use the map there. The entrance is in the **north** of the Green Claw Swamp, a little northeast of the Dwarven Bridge ({coord:32711,31939,7}). To leave, go back up the same way and return to Venore through the swamp.
Swamp of Lost Souls: use the Adventurer's Map here
As soon as you use the map at the **last** of the 18 locations you get the **Cartography 101** achievement.

Go back to {npc:Rotem Valos} and say {key:hi} and {key:map} for the quest to be marked as completed in the Quest Log. Return to the Adventurers' Guild by using an {item:Adventurer's Stone} in the temple of any city.
If you ask Rotem Valos about {key:map} before you finish, he only asks how it is going and reminds you of the {key:list}.
This quest is part of the {wiki:Adventurers Guild (Quest)|Adventurers' Guild} tasks.
